AC amendment (gap G1 — CRITICAL path fix): pytest test path is WRONG. The project layout is `tests/unit/dso_reconciler/` (40+ existing test_*.py files there); `tests/dso_reconciler/` does NOT exist. Pytest collection would be silently empty. Move test file to:
`tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_no_retired_paths_in_workflows.py`
Update all AC paths accordingly. Verify pytest discovers the test: `pytest --collect-only tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_no_retired_paths_in_workflows.py` must show ≥1 collected test.
